title: Ketchup Used to Be Fish Sauce
hook: The word ketchup came from a name for pickled fish brine
summary: Ketchup was first a word for pickled fish brine, and tomato ketchup came along in the 1800s.

text: Nothing goes with fries like ketchup.
But ketchup didn't start out as a tomato sauce.
One explanation is that the word comes from the local language of Fujian, in southern China.
It was the name for brine from pickled fish or shellfish.
Old ketchup recipes used all kinds of things.
There were ketchups made from mushrooms, oysters, mussels and walnuts.
